# UniHelperProMax

> UniHelperProMax is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) study app for university students. It puts a semester timetable, Markdown notes, a PDF slide reader, lecture recording and transcription, AI chat, a Socratic AI tutor and a task board in one place, and keeps everything as plain files on your own disk. It runs as a desktop app on Windows, macOS and Linux, or self-hosted with Docker. Yuii, the pink-haired student on the website, is the app's mascot.

Key facts:

- Price: free, no subscription, no account, no tracking
- License: GNU AGPL-3.0; source code on GitHub
- Platforms: Windows 10+ (x64), macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon), Linux x64 (AppImage, .deb), Docker
- Storage: notes are `.md` files, slides are `.pdf`, recordings are audio files, chats are saved as `.md`
- AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local models through Ollama / LM Studio (fully offline)
- Transcription: any OpenAI-compatible speech API; the transcript is appended to a note and never overwrites what you wrote
- AI tutor: asks questions first (Socratic method), checks how sure you are, keeps a lesson plan and a knowledge graph
- Maker: Nimaj2002 (GitHub)
